correctness.rationale: The source preconditioner gives exactly \(u_{k+1}=u_k[1-\tau/(1+|u_k|^4)^{1/4}]\) after scaling. For \(0<\tau\le2\), the absolute multiplier is strictly below one at every nonzero state, proving global convergence. Taylor expansion gives the fifth-order matched step and the critical recurrence \(v_{k+1}=v_k-\frac12v_k^5+O(v_k^9)\), hence \(v_k\sim(2k)^{-1/4}\). For \(\tau>2\), the origin has multiplier \(1-\tau\), while the exact symmetric two-cycle has one-step derivative \(1-32/\tau^4\); its squared two-step multiplier is strictly below one.

value.rationale: The source explicitly promotes the \(\kappa=4\) nonlinear preconditioner as a more faithful mathematical model of Polar Express, so its fixed-step behavior on the canonical quadratic mode is a natural calibration problem. The exact frontier shows that the smoothing parameter sets a hard learning-rate scale, identifies a fifth-order matched point, and explains the critical slowdown and persistent oscillation immediately beyond stability. These are parameter-design and failure-mode facts for the new model, not an arbitrary scalar slice or a routine recomputation of a known table.
